lines: The Sahara Desert is a very hot place.
It doesn't rain much.
So it is very dry.
Still, some plants grow there.
Peyote cactus
It has a thick stem.
The stem can store a lot of water.
So the cactus can live without rain for a long time.
Also, it has no leaves or branches.
This means the cactus doesn't lose much water.
Olive tree
It has shallow roots.
So the tree gets water fast when it rains.
Its leaves are small and narrow, too.
They help the tree to not lose much water.
Tamarisk shrub
It has deep roots.
These roots take in underground water.
Also, it has thin branches.
So it doesn't need much water to survive.
